title: MT61125: Rate Phenomena In Metallurgical Process
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Laminar and turbulent flow and its application in Metallurgical processesanalysis of metallurgical packed and fluidized bed, fluid-flow in gas-agitated
systems. Techniques of process analysis- dimensional analysis, reactor design
and related application in metallurgical systems. Conductive, convective and
radiative heat transfer in metallurgical systems-heat transfer around single
bubble/particle, in metallurgical packed and fluidized bed, liquid steel
ladles. Mass transfer rates involving diffusion, convection, and its
application in homogeneous and heterogeneous systems.
